verses.text: Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri Yona mwene Amitayi, riti:
“Va hasi uje i Ninewe, ca gisagara kinini, ukiburire, kuko ibibi abakibamwo bakora vyaduze bishika imbere yanje.”

Ariko Yona afata inzira ija i Tarushishi ngo ahunge Uhoraho . Nuko aramanuka aja i Yopa, ahasanga ubwato bugira buje i Tarushishi, ariha amahera y’urugendo, hanyuma aramanuka yinjira mu bwato kugira ngo aje i Tarushishi, ahunge Uhoraho .
Maze Uhoraho ateza umuyaga ukomeye mu kiyaga; haba igihuhusi ku buryo ubwato bwagomba kumeneka.

Abari mu bwato bagira ubwoba bwinshi, maze umwe wese atakambira imana yiwe kugira ngo ibatabare. Bafata ivyo bari batwaye mu bwato babiterera mu kiyaga kugira ngo baburemurure. Ariko Yona we yari yamanutse aja hasi mu bwato, araryama asinzira ubutikoma.
Umukuru w’ubwato aza aho Yona aryamye amubwira ati: “Urubahuka gusinzira ibintu bimeze uku? Vyuka utakambire imana yawe hari n’aho yotugirira imbabazi ntidupfe.”
Maze baravugana bati: “Reka tugire ubupfindo kugira ngo tumenye uwutumye ibi vyago bidushikira.” Bagize ubupfindo, bwerekana ko vyavuye kuri Yona.
Baramubaza bati: “Tubarire: ni kuki ibi vyago bidushikiye? Ukora iki? Uva he? Igihugu cawe ni ikihe? Uva mu bwoko ubuhe?”
Arabishura ati: “Ndi Umuheburayo kandi nsenga Uhoraho , Imana yo mw’ijuru yaremye ikiyaga n’isi.”
Ba bagabo bafatwa n’ubwoba bwinshi baramubaza bati: “Ni kuki wakoze ivyo?” Bari bamaze kumenya ko ariko arahunga ngo aje aho Uhoraho adashobora kumubona kuko yari yamaze kubibabwira.
Kubera ko igihuhusi cakomeza kwiyongeranya, baca baramubaza bati: “None tugukorere iki kugira ngo duhagarike iki gihuhusi ikiyaga gitekane?”
Arabishura ati: “Nimunterure munte mu kiyaga, maze gica gitekana kuko ndazi ko iki gihuhusi gikomeye kije kubera jewe.”
Aho kumuterera mu kiyaga, ba bagabo bagerageza gusoza ubwato ngo busubire ku musozi ariko birabananira, kuko igihuhusi caca kirushiriza gukomera.
Nuko batakambira Uhoraho Imana ya Yona, bati: “ Uhoraho , turakwinginze ntutwice ku bw’ivyaha vy’uwu muntu. Kandi ntuduharureko amaraso y’umuntu, kuko wewe Uhoraho , wakoze ibiguhimbara.”
Nuko baterura Yona bamuterera mu kiyaga, maze ca gihuhusi kirahagarara, ikiyaga kiratekana.
Ba bagabo bagira ubwoba bwinshi ku bw’ Uhoraho , bamushikanira ikimazi, basezerana n’amasezerano imbere yiwe.
Uhoraho aca azana urufi runini cane, rumira Yona, amara imisi itatu n’amajoro atatu mu nda yarwo.
Nuko Yona asenga Uhoraho Imana yiwe ari mu nda y’urwo rufi.
Avuga ati: “Natakambiye Uhoraho ndi mu vyago bikomeye, na we aranyishura. Ndi mu kibanza c’abapfuye, naratakamvye ngo untabare, nawe wumvise ijwi ryanje.
Wantereye kure cane mu kuzimu, kure cane mu mutima w’ikiyaga; imikuba ikomeye yaranzungurutse, imipfunda n’ugusuriranya kw’amazi vyawe vyarandengeye.
Ndavuga nti: ‘Noneho nkuwe imbere y’amaso yawe. Ariko nzosubira nihweze urusengero rwawe rwera.’
Amazi yarandengeye agomba kunyica, i bwina mu mazi haranzunguruka; ivyatsi vyo mu kiyaga binyizingira ku mutwe.
Naranyitse nshikira intango y’imisozi, aho isi yanyugaraniye ubutakivayo. Ariko wewe, Uhoraho Mana yanje, waduganye ubuzima bwanje ubukuye mu cobo.
Igihe ubuzima bwanje bwariko burakabirana, nibutse wewe Uhoraho , ugusenga kwanje kuraduga kuragushikira, mu rusengero rwawe rwera.
Abashira umutima ku bigirwamana bitagira ikimazi, batera umugongo urukundo Imana ibakunda.
Ariko jewe, nzogushikanira ikimazi nshize hejuru ijwi ryo kugushimira. Kandi nzoshitsa ivyo nasezeranye, kuko agakiza kanje kava k’ Uhoraho .”
Maze Uhoraho ategeka urwo rufi, na rwo rudahwa Yona ku nkengera y’ikiyaga.
Hanyuma Uhoraho yongera kubwira Yona ubugira kabiri, ati:
“Va hasi uje muri ca gisagara kinini Ninewe ukimenyeshe bwa butumwa nakubwira.”
Yona aca yumvira ijambo ry’Imana aja i Ninewe. Ninewe cari igisagara kinini ku buryo vyafata imisi itatu kugira ngo umuntu ashobore kugicamwo cose.
Nuko Yona amara umusi umwe agendagenda muri ico gisagara asemerera n’ijwi rirenga ati: “Hasigaye imisi mirongo ine gusa Ninewe hagahona.”
Maze abantu b’i Ninewe bizera ubwo butumwa bw’Imana, baca bashinga ko haba ukwisonzesha kandi uhereye ku mukuru ugashika ku muntu mutoya, bambara amagunira.
Ayo majambo ya Yona ashikiriye umwami w’i Ninewe na we aca arahaguruka ava ku ntebe y’ubwami, yambura impuzu z’ubwami, yambara igunira, yongera yicara mu mukungugu.
Aca atanga itegeko i Ninewe rivuga riti: “Itegeko ry’umwami n’abaganwa biwe: Ntihagire abantu canke ibikoko, amasho n’imikuku bigira ico bikoza ku munwa, ntibigire ico birya canke binywa.
Abantu nibambare amagunira mbere n’ibikoko babiyapfuke, hanyuma abantu batakambire Imana binginga, kandi umuntu wese ave mu nzira z’ibibi, bahagarike n’umuryano uri hagati yabo.
Nta wubizi! Hari n’aho Imana yokwisubirako ikigarura, ikareka ugushangashirwa kwayo, maze ntiduhonye.”
Imana ibona ibikorwa vyabo, ingene bahindukiye bakava mu nzira zabo mbi, maze irigarura ntiyabahanisha igihano yari yabateguriye.
Ariko Yona we, kwigarura kw’Imana kwamuteye ishavu ryinshi.

Ni ko gusenga Uhoraho avuga ati: “None ga Mana ibi si vyo nari navuze igihe nari nkiri mu gihugu c’iwacu? Ni na co cari catumye nihutira guhungira i Tarushishi. Kuko nari nsanzwe nzi ko wewe uri Imana igira ubuntu, ifise ikigongwe cinshi, itihutira gushavura, ifise urukundo rwinshi kandi yigarura ntirungike ivyago.
None rero Uhoraho , nyica, kuko gupfa bindutiye kubaho.”
Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Mbega aho ubona vyari bikwiye ko ushavura?”
Nuko Yona ava mu gisagara aragenda yicara mu buseruko bwaco, yiyubakira akazu ko kwikingamwo izuba, yicara mu gitutu cako, maze arindira kuraba ibishikira igisagara.
Nuko Imana imeza igiterwa c’amababi maninimanini, kirakura kija hejuru y’umutwe wa Yona kimuha agatutu. Ivyo bica bituma Yona yoroherwa maze aranezerwa cane kubera ico giterwa.
Ariko bukeye Imana irongera ituma urunyo ruraza rurya ca giterwa gica kirakabirana.
Izuba rimaze guseruka, Imana ituma umuyaga ushushe uvuye mu buseruko, iryo zuba na ryo rikubita Yona mu mutwe kugeza aho acika intege. Aca asubira kwisabira gupfa ati: “Gupfa vyondutira kubaho.”
Imana yishura Yona iti: “Mbega aho ubona vyari bikwiye ko ushavura ku bw’iki giterwa?” Na we arishura ati: “Birakwiye nyene! Ahubwo ndashavuye gushika n’aho numva nopfuma mpfa.”
Uhoraho aca avuga ati: “Ko ubabajwe n’igiterwa utakoreye canke ngo utume gikura, cakuze mw’ijoro rimwe bukeye kikuma,
mbega jewe sinari nkwiye kugirira ikigongwe Ninewe, igisagara kinini kibamwo abantu barenga ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ibiri badashobora gutandukanya iciza n’ikibi, hamwe n’ibitungano vyaho vyinshi?”
